prompt: This repo is driven by coding agents — read AGENTS.md first. If .env is missing, copy .env.example to .env, then run `pnpm db:start` (local Supabase without Docker; the CLI writes POSTGRES_URL into .env.local) and `pnpm db:push`: a new local database is EMPTY, so the push is not optional. Gate every change with `pnpm verify`.

hooks.command: [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && { id -u supabase-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --user-group supabase-postgres; } && echo 'export SUPABASE_NATIVE_POSTGRES_USER=supabase-postgres' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" || true
